display_name: Acoluthus, companion of Alexander and Barbarus

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Μαΐου, «Άγιοι Αλέξανδρος, Βάρβαρος και Ακόλουθος», with the rank word left off; the life page carries «Αγιος Ακολουθος» as its own head name.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Μαΐου — «Άγιοι Αλέξανδρος, Βάρβαρος και Ακόλουθος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives him as one of three head names on one page — hence three folders. **Nothing in the corpus reads as him**: the namesweep printed no row for the name, and no folder carries it. **The name is kept in the form the page prints**, Ακόλουθος, the follower or attendant, which is the page's own gloss; it is not turned into a description. **No year, no country, so no `dates` and no `locations`.** No hymn is printed.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
